Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) with 5+ years of experience in
mortality experience studies, assumption development and biometric risk
modeling within Life & Health reinsurance. I translate complex experience data
into actionable insights for pricing, valuation and in-force portfolio
management across North American life insurance markets, blending classical
actuarial methods with predictive modeling and an epidemiological perspective.

## Experience

::: {.cv-entry}
**Associate Actuary, Biometric Risks & Experience Analysis** · SCOR  
[United States · May 2024 – present (Senior Actuarial Analyst, Nov 2021 – May 2024)]{.cv-meta}

- Collaborated with a multidisciplinary global team to develop mortality trend
  assumptions for longevity and protection business, incorporating future
  morbidity drivers for pricing and valuation of in-force blocks.
- Led the estimation of Economic Capital for Post-Level Term (PLT) life
  products, focusing on excess lapse and mortality risk through predictive modeling.
- Built a model quantifying mortality trends from delayed cancer screenings due
  to COVID-19 impacts on the U.S. healthcare system.
- Developed a predictive mortality trend model using an embedded risk factors
  approach, supporting forward-looking assumption setting.
- Led the development of policyholder behavior assumptions (lapse and
  conversion) with predictive modeling, improving assumption accuracy by 15%.
- Directed the implementation of lapse and mortality improvement assumptions
  into valuation and pricing models.
- Accelerated assumption validation by automating data preprocessing and model
  calibration with R Shiny tools.
- Enriched mortality risk analysis by integrating public data via APIs, and
  applied machine learning to quantify the value of new data points.
:::
